character: a small round penguin bowler wearing a coral-red bowling shirt

items.prompt: Bowling scene seen from the lane looking at the pin deck. The ten white bowling pins with red stripes each hang from thin dark strings coming down from the machinery above. A bowling ball just hit them: some pins are knocked over but still dangling and swinging on their strings, two strings are tangled together, and three pins are still standing. The penguin stands in the lower left foreground, holding its flippers on its head, staring at the swinging pins with a puzzled, squinting expression. Clean, simple bowling alley background in soft mint and cream colors. Square composition, pin deck clearly visible in the upper center.
